decision.rationale: The Stone Centre is an official Vancouver School of Economics research centre on wealth and income inequality. The homepage evidences research projects and papers, fellowship and grant opportunities, seminars and events, personal research interviews, institutional news and contact support. These distinct sections receive ordered overrides without inventing an academic-course category where none is evidenced.

rules.rationale: Homepage interviews recount the experiences and reflections of fellows and the centre director.
Named grant and fellowship sections describe funding and participation opportunities, including grants nested under Research.
The homepage advertises an open research-grant application call outside the grant section path.
These explicitly linked sections offer seminars, lectures and event participation and override their News & Events parent.
The remaining News & Events section and Latest News report institutional developments.
The homepage's LSE network announcement is institutional news on a root-level article path.
Contact guidance helps readers reach the centre rather than describing research findings.
Research projects, publications and working papers describe the centre's research output; the earlier grant rule handles funding separately.

fallback.rationale: The centre's primary purpose is research on the causes, consequences and remedies of wealth and income inequality.
